alarms.email.recovery.concentrator_note: A restart is not enough. If it persists, reseat the concentrator card in its mPCIe slot and check the power supply (an undervoltage was reported).
alarms.email.batch.left_out: {n} earlier change(s) of this alarm were not e-mailed: at most {limit} e-mails per alarm per hour.
alarms.email.recovery.chirpstack_1: Open the Hub in the portal and read the LoRaWAN rows of the radio card for the reason.
alarms.email.recovery.chirpstack_note: LoRaWAN Nodes cannot be received or commanded while this alarm is active.
alarms.email.recovery.config_1: Open the Node in the portal; its configuration banner lists what did not reach it.
alarms.email.recovery.config_2: Press Send again once the Node is in range: only the Node's part is sent, the Hub already holds the new values.
alarms.email.recovery.config_3: Or press Discard: the Hub and the portal go back to the values from before the send.
alarms.email.recovery.northbridge_1: Open the Hub in the portal and read the Northbridge row of the radio card for the last error.
alarms.email.recovery.northbridge_2: Restart the Hub; the P2P radio is re-initialised on boot.
alarms.email.recovery.northbridge_3: If it persists, power the Hub off for ~10 seconds and back on.
alarms.email.recovery.northbridge_note: LoRa P2P Nodes are not acknowledged while this alarm is active; their readings are recovered from their history once the radio answers again.
alarms.email.recovery.northbridge_update: Open the Hub in the portal and read the last error in the Northbridge firmware card of the System tab.
Restart the Hub; the update is tried again, up to three times per boot.
The Northbridge keeps running its previous firmware if it can; if it does not answer, the Northbridge unreachable alarm follows.
alarms.email.recovery.southbridge_update: Open the Hub in the portal and read the last error in the Southbridge firmware row of the System tab.
Run the update again there (Update Southbridge firmware), with Force if needed; the Hub also retries on restart, up to three times.
The Southbridge keeps running its previous firmware if it can; sensor power and the line LEDs depend on it.
